provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled two-site excitonic linear-response model, not measured material data.

hamiltonian: A real symmetric two-by-two matrix with the supplied site energies on the diagonal and an unknown real intersite coupling V on both off-diagonals. No dissipative width or extra states. The two observed peak energies are exact eigenvalues for the energy inversion.
oscillator_model: Only the first basis state has transition amplitude from the ground state; the second is dark, with no direct amplitude. Normalized peak oscillator strength is squared first-basis component of its normalized eigenvector. Sum of the two fractions is1. Changing the arbitrary phase of the dark basis changes V sign but no stated observable.

additional_observation.criterion: Compatible if absolute predicted-minus-observed fraction is no greater than the tolerance. Do not refit the exact site energies or peak positions to accommodate this observation.

scope: Infer what this finite Hamiltonian and the supplied observables identify; no claim about real exciton localization or arbitrary additional optical transitions.
